feat(ci): publish lris and camellia images

Summary:
- add a dedicated Dockerfile for camellia and trim Docker contexts
- replace the spectra image with a shared lris image and wrapper entrypoint
- update staging and production dyn-workflows to publish lris and camellia

Rationale:
- camellia needs first-class image publishing in the existing CI flow
- spectra should ship from a shared lris image instead of its own image name
- database migrations should no longer be embedded in the runtime image path

Tests:
- cd lris && cargo check --workspace
- cd bougainvillea && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check:camellia
- docker build -f bougainvillea/apps/camellia/Dockerfile bougainvillea
- docker build -f lris/Dockerfile lris (validated with a temporary placeholder binary because local musl cross-compilation was unavailable)
